hypothesis: S85-CTXFUS: a fault is a line in context, not a pixel. A contextual supervised field (HistGradientBoosting on 24 catalogue-free channels + 6 line-context channels: 1.5 km along-strike line support, multi-scale context means, 5-field corroboration count; trained per-fold on visible catalogue only) rank-fused 50/50 with the GEO-Pb juxtaposition crest ranks concealed-fault pixels better than either field alone.
mechanism: The two fields fail differently: GEO-Pb fires on joint multi-physics steps (incl. non-fault contacts); the contextual HGB fires on the learned multi-scale appearance of mapped traces (incl. cultural lineaments). Rank-averaging keeps pixels both mechanisms endorse and demotes idiosyncratic false positives of each.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Erosional volcanic mesa / lava-flow margins (straight, multi-domain, line-like at 1.5 km context) — declared irreducible in the GEO-Pb lane and not removed here; secondary: cultural lineaments (roads/canals) with fault-like line context.
